div.head: Shiji I: Basic Annals
div.p: Basic Annals of Qin: In the first year of King Xiaowen, he pardoned offenders, honoured the meritorious servants of the former kings, bestowed generous favour on his kinsmen, and opened the parks and preserves. When King Xiaowen had put off mourning, he came to the throne in October, on the day Jihai; on the third day, Xinchou, he died, and his son King Zhuangxiang was set up.

div.head: Shiji III: Hereditary Houses
div.p: Hereditary House of Zhao: In the sixteenth year, Lian Po besieged Yan. Yue Cheng was made Lord Wuxiang.
